title: Monster Party in Ruins
description: A surreal graffiti-style painting depicts a giant blue tentacled monster with a large yellow eye and multiple grinning faces emerging from a cracked wall. Four women in blue outfits dance around it, one holding a spray can while painting its face, set against ruined arches under a green starry sky with yellow flowers and graffiti.
